parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description: The ID of the database. Call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) API to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: The pagination offset. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search on knowledge content.

parameters.name: ShowType
parameters.description: The type of knowledge to return. Valid values: `TABLE`, `COLUMN`, `SQL`, and `SEG`. If this parameter is omitted, all types are returned.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. The default value is 20.
